description: The file defines a FavoritesProvider class that manages favorite recipes, extending ChangeNotifier for state management in a Flutter application. It provides initialization status and a method to retrieve favorite recipes from a given RecipeProvider.

classes.name: FavoritesProvider
classes.description: Manages favorite recipes state, allows initialization, and fetches favorite recipes from a RecipeProvider.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets the provider as initialized and notifies listeners.

methods.name: favoritesFrom
methods.description: Returns a list of recipes marked as favorites from the provided RecipeProvider.
